correctness.rationale: All associative derivations of M_n(F_q) are inner. Odd-characteristic trace-pairing skew-adjointness forces a composition-idempotent derivation to vanish. In characteristic two D^2=D iff B^2+B is scalar, giving split idempotent projectors and nonsplit Artin-Schreier quadratic classes, with centralizer ranks 2r(n-r) and n²/2. Orbit–stabilizer yields the coefficients. q-Gaussian binomial product estimates show the theta-series nonsplit mass and total-variation discrete rank-deficit limit. Independent exhaustive GF(2) scalar-normalized generator enumeration gives n=2: {0:1,2:4}, n=3:{0:1,4:28}, n=4:{0:1,6:120,8:336}; numerical infinite-product calculation confirms q=2 limit 0.07435748735 and q=4 limit 0.31099575290.
residual_risks: The finite generator checks do not prove arbitrary n, q or asymptotic convergence.
